digest.component_or_area: plan review criterion registration and container pass
propositions: A new 1-TURN criterion `ac-satisfiability` in facet `coherence` detects when a plan's acceptance criteria and scope declarations are mutually unsatisfiable, covering universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality contradictions.

The sibling roster sent to the container pass must carry each child's acceptance-criteria items extracted via `evaluate_plan_clarity(...).ac_items`, enabling G3 to test whether siblings cover parent acceptance criteria.

The roster-building expression must be single-sourced via a shared `build_sibling_roster` helper called from pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, and eval_solver.py to prevent divergence between production and eval paths.

The roster must be moved from per-pairing instructions into the system prompt as a byte-stable prefix, included in the `parent_tokens` estimate to account for its token cost in bin-packing and caching decisions.
The `ac-satisfiability` criterion ships advisory at default 0.95 posture without blocking, and G3's posture and threshold remain unchanged pending dogfooding data.
Pass-2's verifier `internal_conflict` axis already grades the defect, so no changes to `src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/` are required.
